description: Experiment 4: communication strategy. The fixed problem P on 16 ranks x 1 thread, with row or 2D decomposition and blocking or overlapping halo exchange (four runs). --exchange applies to the pigment exchange (once per step) and to the CG exchange (every iteration); the CG's global sums always wait. The layout stays at pure MPI, where communication matters most. See docs/experiment_plan.md.
